title: Impact of Reactive Oxygen and Nitrogen Species Produced by Plasma on Mdm2-p53 Complex.
authors: Attri, Pankaj; Kurita, Hirofumi; Koga, Kazunori; Shiratani, Masaharu
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究等离子体氧化对Mdm2-p53蛋白复合物结构的影响，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The study of protein-protein interactions is of great interest. Several early studies focused on the murine double minute 2 (Mdm2)-tumor suppressor protein p53 interactions. However, the effect of plasma treatment on Mdm2 and p53 is still absent from the literature. This study investigated the structural changes in Mdm2, p53, and the Mdm2-p53 complex before and after possible plasma oxidation through molecular dynamic (MD) simulations. MD calculation revealed that the oxidized Mdm2 bounded or unbounded showed high flexibility that might increase the availability of tumor suppressor protein p53 in plasma-treated cells. This study provides insight into Mdm2 and p53 for a better understanding of plasma oncology.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的研究备受关注。早期多项研究聚焦于鼠双微体2（Mdm2）与肿瘤抑制蛋白p53之间的相互作用。然而，关于等离子体处理对Mdm2和p53的影响，文献中仍缺乏相关报道。本研究通过分子动力学（MD）模拟，探讨了可能发生等离子体氧化前后Mdm2、p53及Mdm2-p53复合物的结构变化。MD计算揭示，氧化后的Mdm2无论是否结合，均表现出高灵活性，这可能增加等离子体处理细胞中肿瘤抑制蛋白p53的可用性。本研究为深入理解Mdm2和p53提供了见解，有助于更好地认识等离子体肿瘤学。
